controls: unaltered native model reproduces saved full binary predictions
replay captured same-image raw gate logits must reproduce native full predictions
interventions: all raw gate logits replaced by label-free validation-wide channel means
three independent fixed no-self derangements of native raw gates; same image permutation across all levels
replace only one level with mean logits, levels2/1/0
replace only decoder-derived MLP logits by their mean in all levels
replace only skip-derived MLP logits by their mean in all levels
unit gate weights with native final ReLU retained
thresholds: fixed0.5; no threshold or checkpoint search
metrics: same common evaluation.py all metrics and per-image records; exploratory paired image bootstrap
interpretation: Post-training interventions, not retrained ablations. Mean and shuffled gates preserve some but not all activation statistics. Identity changes amplitude and is not alone evidence of a bug. Label-free means use this validation cohort and are not a deployable calibrated model. No claim about all MambaVision or original UCTransNet.
stopping_rule: One bounded audit; do not add attention families or launch new100epoch training automatically.
